evidence.contextAndScope: FIT/ITS structure, hashing/signing, bootm configuration selection, load/entry metadata, command line and overlays in Bootloader chapter 15.
evidence.problemSignalAndCounterevidence: The article claimed CONFIG_FIT_SIGNATURE alone rejects every unsigned FIT, referenced CONFIG_FIT_SIGNATURE_STRICT, asserted unconditional compatible-based selection and bootargs override, and showed fabricated output. U-Boot v2025.01 signature docs say required public-key properties define enforcement; bootm docs define selection syntax; FIT overlay docs document ordered FDT lists. FIT_BEST_MATCH is a build-dependent condition for compatible matching.
evidence.causeHypothesisAndAlternatives: Configuration, signature enablement, required-key policy and runtime selection were conflated; synthetic output was written as if observed. Corrected the required-key distinction, qualified compatible/overlay behavior, removed the unverified bootargs example and exact-looking logs, and marked remaining DTS fragments illustrative.
evidence.evidence: U-Boot v2025.01 FIT docs identify FIT packaging; signature docs describe trusted control-FDT keys and required="image"/"conf"; bootm docs define FIT configuration arguments; overlay docs show ordered FDT overlay configuration: https://docs.u-boot.org/en/v2025.01/usage/fit/index.html ; https://docs.u-boot.org/en/v2025.01/usage/fit/signature.html ; https://docs.u-boot.org/en/v2025.01/usage/cmd/bootm.html ; https://docs.u-boot.org/en/v2025.01/usage/fit/overlay-fdt-boot.html
